tools.summary: Read-only compact observability for a bounded, neutral tool-use audit catalog.
tools.notes: Operator/coordinator observability surface for a compact, redacted, NEUTRAL tool-use catalog from the workspace_tool_usage_audit MCP route. It returns descriptive facts only -- counts by tool/source/confidence, provenance buckets, first-tool-per-bucket, and response-size indicators -- and renders NO misuse or adherence verdict. Misuse assessment is an OFFLINE, out-of-band activity performed by a human or throwaway script over the exported catalog facts; it is never performed by this runtime tool. It does not dispatch agents, mutate records, run lint/generate, block or authorize calls, route agents, scrape broad logs, or reinterpret domain tool authority. The offline vocabulary lives in packages/wiki-core/data/tool-use-policy.v1.json under WK-1437.
